comparison.objective: Fit push-fit elbows to copper and plastic pipes, first inserting a support insert into the plastic pipe.
comparison.physical_skill: Material-dependent sequencing and three coaxial push insertions.
comparison.success_condition: Both elbows seated, with the insert under the plastic joint and none in copper; premature plastic fitting is latched as failure.
comparison.reason: Although both require axial alignment with small openings, this task tests insertion and assembly rather than impact removal and recovery.
